name: Sean Brady
photo_coverage: 15 photos; recency is good (6 from May 2026, UFC 328). Frontal: UFC studio headshot (May 2026), UFC 328 post-fight (May 2026, with a swollen left eye), a 2024 webcam still (Commons CC BY 3.0). Three-quarter: UFC 322 and UFC London media days, a Getty octagon shot, the London face-off. Profile: UFC 328 face-off (left side, near 90 degrees). Body: studio cutouts from May 2026 and Mar 2025, plus four weigh-in shots. No photo shows his back.

face.shape: Square-to-rectangular face, broad through the cheekbones and jaw; the full beard squares off the lower face further. Medium length.
face.jaw: Wide and strong, with the angles far out under the ears; the beard hides the exact line but the width is clear in profile and frontal views.
face.chin: Broad and moderately projecting under the beard; in profile the beard extends well forward of the chin.
face.cheekbones: Broad and fairly prominent; cheeks firm, not hollow.
face.brow_ridge: Heavy and straight; the brows sit low and shade the eyes.
face.forehead: Medium height, broad, with faint horizontal lines; the hairline is cut straight across.

eyes.shape: Medium almond eyes, slightly deep-set under the heavy brow; lower lids a little puffy. Outer corners level to slightly downturned.

eyebrows.shape: Straight and low, close to the eyes, with a slight downward angle at the outer ends; the inner ends sit fairly close together.

nose.width: Medium bridge, moderately wide at the base.
nose.bridge: High and straight; very slightly convex at mid-bridge in profile.
nose.tip: Rounded, slightly full, pointing a little downward; projects strongly in profile.
nose.fight_damage: No obvious break or deviation; the bridge looks a little thickened compared with an undamaged nose (low confidence).

mouth.upper_lip: Thin, mostly hidden under the moustache.
mouth.resting_expression: Closed, firm, corners level to slightly down; serious, stern look in most photos.

ears.size: Medium, made to look bigger by thickening.
ears.protrusion: Moderate; they stand out partly because of the swollen cartilage.
ears.cauliflower_ear: Yes, both ears. The left ear is the most swollen (rounded, lumpy, folds filled in; clear in the 2024 webcam still, the May 2026 studio headshot and the UFC 328 profile). The right ear has a thickened, irregular rim (Getty octagon shot).
ears.notes: A wrestler's ears; a strong recognition cue in close-ups.

face.notable_marks_scars: No large scars visible. Post-fight (May 2026) swelling and redness around the left eye are temporary. Faint forehead lines.

hair.style: Short textured crop: about 3-4 cm on top, pushed forward with a fairly straight front edge, over a high skin fade on the sides and back (skin at the bottom, blending up to about 1 cm at the temples).
hair.colour: Dark brown, darker and less red than the beard.
hair.hairline: Straight across with slight recession at the temples.

facial_hair.colour: Auburn to copper-brown, clearly redder and lighter than the head hair, with ginger highlights in strong light.
facial_hair.density: Dense on the chin, jaw and moustache; dense on the lower cheeks.
facial_hair.shape: Full beard, trimmed neat: about 8-10 mm on the cheeks and 20-25 mm on the chin, slightly squared at the bottom. Cheek line natural and fairly high, edged clean. Neckline under the jaw. Moustache full and joined to the beard, covering the upper lip.

tone_samples.light: press-room light; next to the fight swelling

skin.sampling_method: Median of a 7-11 px box per spot, checked on an overlay sheet. Highlights, shadow and the swollen area are listed but excluded.
skin.tone_note: Fair-to-light skin with warm, ruddy cheeks; #d9967f is the suggested render albedo.
skin.undertone: Warm with red/pink flushing on the cheeks and nose.
skin.freckles_marks: Even tone where visible; most of the body is tattooed. Light chest hair between the pecs (ceremonial weigh-in).
skin.texture_pick: middleage_caucasian_male (swatch #dab396) tinted toward #d9967f, slightly ruddier on the cheeks.

body.build: Compact, dense and muscular: a wrestler's frame. Reach 182.9 cm is 5 cm more than his height. Thick through the neck, chest and thighs.
body.body_fat_note: Lean at fight week with visible abs and obliques; thick rather than shredded.
body.shoulders: Broad, with round, capped deltoids and thick trapezius muscles.
body.arms: Muscular arms with big biceps and thick forearms; fully tattooed.
body.waist: Solid and moderately narrow; clear but not extreme V-taper.
body.legs_calves: Thick, powerful thighs and well-developed calves; fully tattooed.
body.neck: Thick and muscular, tattooed on both sides.
body.posture: Upright with the chest out and shoulders slightly forward; arms hang with a slight bend and fists closed. Steady, square stance in the studio cutouts.
body.notable_physique_traits: Dense grappler's build, thick neck, near-total tattoo coverage of chest, arms and legs, cauliflower ears, full auburn beard.

tattoos.where: Right arm, full sleeve from shoulder to wrist
tattoos.description: Mostly black-and-grey sleeve: a Japanese hannya demon mask in colour (white face, red, yellow eyes, horns, teal tassels) on the front of the right shoulder; below it scenic and figurative work (a horse and rider scene, storm clouds), a red Greek-key band on the inner upper arm, and a portrait of the Virgin Mary with rays on the forearm.

tattoos.where: Left arm, full sleeve from shoulder to wrist
tattoos.description: Japanese-style colour sleeve: a dragon in gold, green and teal scales winding down from the shoulder, with red accents, and a tiger with orange and black stripes on the forearm.
Large black gothic blackletter lettering 'IRISH PRIDE' arching across the top of the chest, over grey smoke/cloud shading.

tattoos.where: Centre of the chest (sternum) down to the upper abdomen
tattoos.description: Large black-and-grey Celtic cross with knotwork and a rose at the centre.
tattoos.size: About 30 cm tall x 15 cm wide

tattoos.description: Black-and-grey skull wearing a top hat, surrounded by shamrocks left as skin-coloured negative space.

tattoos.where: Left pec and front of the left shoulder
tattoos.description: Head of the Japanese dragon from the left sleeve, in gold, green and red, with whiskers; joins the sleeve.

tattoos.where: Left side of the abdomen and ribs
tattoos.description: Realistic two-figure wrestling scene in skin tones and grey: one wrestler gripping the other around the head and body.
tattoos.size: About 25 cm tall x 15 cm wide

tattoos.description: Colour Japanese-style piece in black, red and some orange (a dragon or creature head with red flame or wind bars).
Colour bird/creature in orange-yellow, grey and blue-grey; reads as a dragon or eagle head in profile shots.

tattoos.where: Both legs, full sleeves from upper thigh to ankle
tattoos.description: Japanese-style colour leg sleeves: on the right leg a green and black dragon with flowers and red accents; on the left leg red, black and grey work with peonies/cherry blossoms and red geometric bars.
Right foot: an orange tiger head. Left foot: a black panther head with a red mouth.

tattoos.where: Fingers and backs of both hands
tattoos.description: Small black lettering and symbols on the fingers and knuckles, unreadable at this resolution.

accessories_seen: Dog-tag style chain at weigh-ins (May 2026), a teal wristband at the UFC 328 weigh-in, a 'grit & guillotines' cap at media day.

kit.typical_shorts: UFC/Venum board-style fight shorts (above the knee). May 2026 studio kit: blue with a darker tonal wave pattern, black UFC waistband tab, white check detail on the waistband sides, crypto.com logo. Mar 2025 studio kit: blue with a white slash pattern. Weigh-in (UFC 322): red and black Venum trunks.

morphs_extra._note: Outside the requested morph list but present in assets/embed/mh-shapes-x (src/avatar3d.js reads this block). Ear thickening stands in for cauliflower ear; left more than right.

render_hints.eyebrows: eyebrow001 tinted #492a21, thick, low and straight
render_hints.hair: short02 tinted #42322a with a high skin fade on the sides; beard tinted #553428 (redder than the hair)

notes: Confidence: high for hair, beard, skin, build and the main tattoos; medium for face proportions; low-to-medium for exact morph values. What to watch: (1) The beard must be auburn/copper and clearly redder than the dark-brown hair; full and neat, longer at the chin. (2) Cauliflower ears, left worse than right. (3) Heavy low straight brows over deep-set brown eyes, and a long, strongly projecting nose with a rounded, slightly drooping tip. (4) Square face, thick neck, dense compact build. (5) Tattoos cover nearly everything below the jaw: 'IRISH PRIDE' across the upper chest, a Celtic cross on the sternum, a top-hat skull with shamrocks on his right pec, a colour dragon on his left pec flowing into the left sleeve, a black-and-grey right sleeve with a colour hannya mask on the shoulder, a wrestling scene on his left ribs, both neck sides and both legs. Mirror-check sides. (6) The swollen left eye in the May 2026 post-fight photo is temporary. Macro ageOldM 0.123 uses (33-25)/65 (he turns 34 on 2026-11-23). heightUpM 0.05 is a guess for 178 cm; the avatar scales to official height. Values symmetric except the ear thickening; l-/r- refer to the character's own sides.
